stages.title: Curate high-impact agent skills
steps: Audit installed skills and sources in skills-lock.json.
Install targeted skills from BMAD, Hermes, or WDS — not --all by default.
Pin a short list in .hermes.md or a skills-picks.yaml you can share.
useCases: Reduce skill roulette in long agent sessions
Onboard teammates to the same BMAD + Hermes stack
Document why each skill is worth installing

stages.title: Set up BMAD in your repo
steps: Install BMAD Method and verify _bmad/bmm/config.yaml paths.
Load skills via npx skills add from BMAD-METHOD.
Run bmad-help to get the next recommended planning skill.

stages.title: Personal Hermes AI stack
steps: Install Hermes CLI and migrate config to your repo workdir.
Install gateway so cron runs without an open terminal.
Create a toolkit-education-review cron and .hermes.md context file.
useCases: Self-improving toolkit pages on a 12h loop
Pair Hermes cron with BMAD/WDS skills

stages.title: Score design outputs before review
steps: Write intent and pass/fail acceptance criteria.
Copy design-standards-rubric.md and adapt for your system.
Attach Excalidraw or Figma artefact; score before share.
useCases: Fewer prompt iterations on agent-assisted UI
Higher first-pass acceptance in design review
Shared pass bar before Figma comments or Slack threads

stages.title: Score research and design loop
stages.meta: path convention, rubric workshop, agent prompt
steps: Agree where rubrics and outputs live (repo, drive, or links).
Run the workshop; save customized research and design rubrics.
Score before share; rerun agent review until the score log shows pass.
useCases: One quality bar for research synthesis and design evidence
Works with any chat or IDE agent - no required vendor
Score log the whole team can read

stages.title: Self-improving toolkit loop
steps: Let Hermes cron patch gaps until all published pages pass.
